coverage_summary: One primary-source daily structural scan of infrastructure, energy, logistics, regulation, productivity, production, credit access and institutions. New Korean MOTIR 1 Nov data show electrical-equipment monthly export record $1.99bn (+74% y/y), including AI datacentre transformers/wires/cables. This is a distinct provisional grid-equipment supplier leverage signal, not proof of commissioned megawatts or durable productivity. Reviewed prior Korea HBM4, BOJ ETF, Australia energy, Brazil seized-assets and other staged candidates to avoid duplication. China 31 Oct PMI small-firm weakness remains a survey, not proven structural credit rationing. No change to canonical Atlas.

sources_checked.name: Korean MOTIR October exports and imports

review_limitations: Electrical-equipment exports are nominal customs receipts, not shipment volume, installed capacity or measured productive efficiency.
One month of record sales is not enough to determine durable grid access, margins or customer concentration.
No independent power-connection commissioning, MW capacity, lead-time or contract fulfillment dataset for the Korean equipment exported in October.
No canonical Atlas state or historical event changed.
